builds.d: A build that increases the number of skill attack hits and progressively expands their range.
A DPS build that accumulates and consumes Energy to launch Shadow Scythe to slice targets.

l.b: Increases the Main Skill's DMG and number of slashes.
l.s: Sleight of Scythe (Main Skill) will launch ⟦0⟧ more strikes. Increases Skill DMG by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When casting Sleight of Scythe (Main Skill), each strike becomes more powerful.
l.s: When casting Sleight of Scythe (Main Skill), each strike becomes more powerful.  Each strike increases Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ and Attack Range by ⟦1⟧ for a total of 3 times.

l.b: Increases ATK and Movement SPD while casting the Main Skill.
l.s: Casting Sleight of Scythe (Main Skill) increases Coronis' Movement SPD.  Also increases ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases the Main Skill's DMG to targets with ⟨Dark Shackles⟩.
l.s: Increases Sleight of Scythe' (Main Skill) DMG to targets with ⟨Dark Shackles⟩ by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Nearby targets with ⟨Dark Shackles⟩ increase Coronis' ATK.
l.s: For every target with ⟨Dark Shackles⟩ nearby, increases Coronis' ATK by ⟦0⟧, up to 3 stacks.

l.b: Casting the Main Skill grants ⟨Nether Energy⟩. Auto Attacks consume ⟨Nether Energy⟩ to unleash Shadow Scythes.
l.s: When casting Sleight of Scythe (Main Skill), gains ⟦0⟧ stacks of ⟨Nether Energy⟩. Each Auto Attack will automatically consume 2 stacks of ⟨Nether Energy⟩ to launch 3 Shadow Scythes, dealing ⟦1⟧ as Umbra Auto Attack DMG.

l.b: The last strike of Auto Attack grants ⟨Nether Energy⟩. Auto Attacks consume ⟨Nether Energy⟩ to unleash Shadow Scythes.
l.s: When launching the final strike of Midnight Cleave, gains ⟦0⟧ stack of ⟨Nether Energy⟩. Each Auto Attack will automatically consume 2 stacks of ⟨Nether Energy⟩ to launch 3 Shadow Scythes, each dealing ⟦1⟧ as Umbra Auto Attack DMG.

l.b: Shadow Scythes will release venom when dealing DMG. Increases Coronis's ATK.
l.s: Shadow Scythes will release venom when dealing DMG, dealing ⟦0⟧ as AoE Umbra Auto Attack DMG every 0.5s for 6s. Increases Coronis's ATK by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When Coronis triggers ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩, increases the target's Umbra DMG Taken.
l.s: When Coronis triggers ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩, increases the target's Umbra DMG Taken by ⟦0⟧ for 10s.

l.b: When dodging, increases Coronis's ATK.
l.s: When dodging, increases Coronis's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 4s.

l.b: The Ultimate can trigger ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩. Increases Mark DMG.
l.s: Void Reaper (Ultimate) can trigger ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩. Increases Mark DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Coronis can dodge one more time. Increases her DEF when dodging.
l.s: Coronis can dodge one more time. When dodging, increases her DEF by ⟦0⟧ for 10s.

l.b: Coronis can dodge through barriers. Increases her ATK.
l.s: Coronis can dodge through barriers. Increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases the Ultimate's Resilience Break Efficiency. The more targets the final horizontal slash hits, the higher the DMG will be.
l.s: For each target the horizontal slash hits during Void Reaper (Ultimate), increases the DMG of this hit by ⟦0⟧, up to 3 stacks.  Increases Void Reaper's Resilience Break Efficiency by 30%.

l.b: When casting the Ultimate, increases the main Trekker's Mark DMG.
l.s: When casting Void Reaper (Ultimate), increases the main Trekker's Mark DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 10s.

l.b: The Ultimate has increased DMG to targets with Resilience.
l.s: When Void Reaper (Ultimate) deals DMG to a target with Resilience, increases its DMG by ⟦0⟧.

builds.d: A build that launches Shadow Scythe with skills, capable of performing multiple horizontal sweeps against a single target.
A support build that pulls powerful enemies and drops Potent Potions that enhance the main Trekker.

l.b: The Support Skill unleashes multiple Shadow Scythes. Increases the Resilience Break Efficiency of horizontal sweeps and Shadow Scythes.
l.s: When launching a horizontal sweep with Bone Chain (Support Skill), unleashes 3 Shadow Scythes, dealing ⟦0⟧ as Umbra Skill DMG and inflicting ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩. While casting Bone Chain (Support Skill), increases the Resilience Break Efficiency of the horizontal sweep and Shadow Scythes by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: The Support Skill unleashes multiple Shadow Scythes to the opposite direction. Increases the Resilience Break Efficiency of horizontal sweeps and Shadow Scythes.
l.s: When Coronis breaks the chains with Bone Chain (Support Skill), unleashes 3 Shadow Scythes to the opposite direction, dealing ⟦0⟧ as Umbra Skill DMG and inflicting ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩. While casting Bone Chain (Support Skill), increases the Resilience Break Efficiency of the horizontal sweep and Shadow Scythes by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: Launches a second sweep after dealing DMG to a target inflicted with the Support Skill's horizontal sweep. Increases the Resilience Break Efficiency of horizontal sweeps and Shadow Scythes.
l.s: When Coronis deals DMG to a target with the horizontal sweep of the Support Skill Bone Chain, launches a second sweep, dealing ⟦0⟧ as Umbra Skill DMG. While casting the Support Skill Bone Chain, increases the Resilience Break Efficiency of the horizontal sweep and Shadow Scythes by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When Coronis inflicts ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩, increases her ATK.
l.s: When Coronis inflicts ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 10s, stacking up to 3 times.

l.b: When the horizontal sweep deals DMG to elite or higher-tier targets, increases Coronis' ATK.
l.s: When Coronis deals DMG to an elite or higher-tier target with a horizontal sweep during Bone Chain (Support Skill), increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, stacking up to 2 times.

l.b: When the Support Skill's horizontal sweep deals DMG, there is a chance to gain a Potent Potion, which increases her Mark DMG when picked up.
l.s: When Coronis deals DMG with a horizontal sweep during Bone Chain (Support Skill), there is a ⟦0⟧ chance to gain a Potent Potion. Upon picking it up, increases her Mark DMG by ⟦1⟧ for 10s, stacking up to 3 times.

l.b: Releases venom when breaking the chains with the Support Skill.
l.s: When Coronis breaks the chains with Bone Chain (Support Skill), releases venom that deals ⟦0⟧ as AoE Umbra Skill DMG every 0.5s for a total of 6s. Venom DMG can inflict ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩.

l.b: When the Support Skill's chains bind multiple targets, increases Skill DMG when Coronis breaks the chains.
l.s: When Coronis bind 3 or more targets using Bone Chain (Support Skill), increases Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ when she breaks the chains.

l.b: The Support Skill can pull stronger targets. Increases Skill DMG when Coronis breaks the chains.
l.s: Bone Chain (Support Skill) can bind and pull stronger targets. Increases Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ when Coronis breaks the chains.

l.b: When Coronis deals DMG by breaking the chains (Support Skill), increases the target's Umbra DMG Taken.
l.s: When Coronis deals DMG by breaking the chains during Bone Chain (Support Skill), increases the target's Umbra DMG Taken by ⟦0⟧ for 10s.

l.b: Increases Umbra Trekkers' ATK.
l.s: Increases Umbra Trekkers' ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases Coronis' Skill DMG. The Ultimate can inflict ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩.
l.s: Void Reaper (Ultimate) can inflict ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩. Increases Coronis' Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When the Support Skill deals DMG, reduces the target's Resilience. Increases Coronis' ATK.
l.s: When Coronis deals DMG with Bone Chain (Support Skill), reduces the target's Resilience by 5%. This effect can only be triggered once every 12s. Increases Coronis's ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases the Ultimate's Resilience Break Efficiency. The more targets the final horizontal slash hits, the higher the DMG will be.
l.s: For each target the horizontal slash hits during Void Reaper (Ultimate), increases the DMG of this hit by ⟦0⟧, up to 3 stacks.  Increases Void Reaper's Resilience Break Efficiency by 30%.

l.b: When casting the Ultimate, increases the main Trekker's Mark DMG.
l.s: When casting Void Reaper (Ultimate), increases the main Trekker's Mark DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 10s.

l.b: The Ultimate has increased DMG to targets with Resilience.
l.s: When Void Reaper (Ultimate) deals DMG to a target with Resilience, increases its DMG by ⟦0⟧.
